title: A minimized Studio window renders blank (white) screen captures while the game keeps running
observation: Mid-session, every Studio MCP screen capture came back white in play and in edit, with the game running at 60 fps and no errors; a test that moved the camera seemed broken. The Studio window had been minimized. Restoring it without activating it (ShowWindow with SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE) brought captures back without taking the person's keyboard focus.
recommendation: Before debugging blank captures, check whether Studio is minimized (IsIconic) or the display is asleep; restore it without stealing focus and say so to the person.
applies_when: Taking screenshots of Studio from an agent while a person may be using the same computer
